item.title: Husband Stabs Son to Death, NHIS Demands Mother Pay Medical Costs... Anti-Corruption Commission Says "Cancel the Claim" (남편이 아들 찌르고 죽었는데 아내에게 ‘치료비 물어내라’ 한 건보공단… 권익위 “청구 취소하라”)
item.description:
Husband Stabs Son to Death, NHIS Demands Mother Pay Medical Costs... Anti-Corruption Commission Says "Cancel the Claim" (남편이 아들 찌르고 죽었는데 아내에게 ‘치료비 물어내라’ 한 건보공단… 권익위 “청구 취소하라”)

In a case where a husband severely injured his son and then died, the National Health Insurance Service (NHIS) demanded that the wife, who lives with the son, pay back the son’s medical expenses. The Anti-Corruption and Civil Rights Commission recommended that the NHIS cancel the claim, calling it unjust. (남편이 아들에게 중상을 입히고 본인은 사망한 사건에서 국민건강보험공단이 아들과 같이 사는 아내에게 아들 치료비를 물어내라고 청구했다. 국민권익위원회는 청구가 부당하다며 건보공단에 청구를 취소하라고 권고했다.)

According to the commission on the 21st, while married couple A and B were going through an appeal in their divorce proceedings, B swung a weapon at their son C, causing serious injuries, and then died. (21일 권익위에 따르면, 부부인 A씨와 B씨가 이혼 소송 항소심을 진행하던 중 B씨가 아들 C씨에게 흉기를 휘둘러 중상을 입히고 본인은 숨졌다.)

The NHIS claimed tens of millions of won from A for the medical costs it covered related to C’s treatment. Normally, the NHIS would exercise its right of recourse against the perpetrator, B, to recover the costs, but because B had died and B’s legal heir was A, the NHIS targeted her instead. (건보공단은 C씨 치료와 관련해 건보공단이 부담한 수천만원을 A씨에게 청구했다. 원래는 범죄 가해자인 B씨에게 구상권을 행사해 B씨에게 구상금을 청구해야 하지만, B씨가 사망했고 B씨의 법정 상속인은 A씨라는 이유에서였다.)

A and B had received a first-instance divorce ruling, and were disputing property division in the second trial. However, B’s death ended the lawsuit without a final ruling, and the marital relationship between A and B was not dissolved, making A B’s legal heir. (A씨와 B씨는 이혼 소송 1심에서 이혼하라는 판결을 받았고, 재산 분할 등을 두고 2심에서 다투고 있는 상황이었다. 그런데 B씨가 숨지면서 소송이 확정 판결 없이 종료됐고, A씨와 B씨의 혼인 관계도 해소되지 못한 까닭에 A씨는 B씨의 법정 상속인이 됐다.)

A believed the divorce was finalized based on the first-instance ruling and thought she didn’t need to renounce inheritance. While legally she was the perpetrator’s heir, she was also the mother who had to care for the victim, and she filed a complaint with the commission, arguing that exercising recourse against her was too harsh. (A씨는 1심 판결에 따라 이혼이 확정된 것으로 생각해 상속 포기를 하지 않아도 되는 것으로 생각했고, 법적으로는 가해자의 상속인이지만 피해자를 돌봐야 하는 어머니이기도 한데 자신에게 구상권을 행사하는 것은 가혹하다며 권익위에 민원을 냈다.)

The commission determined that while the NHIS has the right to exercise recourse against a third party when insurance benefits are paid due to a third party’s actions, A, as the perpetrator’s heir, bears liability for damages to the victim C, but also lives in the same household with C, is enrolled in the same health insurance, and shares its benefits. Thus, she does not qualify as a “third party” subject to recourse. (권익위는 건보공단이 ‘제삼자의 행위로 보험금을 지급해야 할 사유가 생겼을 때’ 이 제삼자에게 구상권을 행사할 권리를 갖지만, A씨는 가해자의 상속인으로서 피해자인 C씨에게 손해배상 책임을 지는 사람인 동시에 C씨와 한 가구를 이루고 있으면서 함께 건강보험에 가입해 보험의 이익을 누리는 관계에 있으므로, 구상권 행사 대상인 ‘제삼자’에 해당하지 않는다고 판단했다.)

The commission pointed out that recognizing the NHIS’s recourse against A in this relationship would strip A and C of the benefits of health insurance enrollment, effectively treating them as if they were not enrolled, which contradicts the utility of insurance. If the NHIS’s recourse were allowed, a paradox would arise where A and C would have to repay the NHIS for any future medical costs related to this incident, despite being insured and having the NHIS cover those costs on their behalf. (권익위는 이런 관계에서도 건보공단의 A씨에 대한 구상권 행사를 인정하게 되면, A씨와 C씨에게서 건강보험 가입의 이익을 빼앗고 건강보험에 가입하지 않은 것과 마찬가지의 효과를 내게 되는데, 이는 보험의 효용성에 반하는 것이라고 지적했다. 건보공단의 구상권 행사가 인정되면, A씨와 C씨는 앞으로도 이 사건과 관련해 치료비가 발생할 때마다 자신들이 건강보험에 가입해서 건보공단이 대신 내준 치료비를 건보공단에 물어내야 하는 역설이 생긴다는 것이다.)

The NHIS argued that since A had not renounced inheritance, she should be liable for damages as an heir. However, the commission’s investigation revealed that even though B’s death nullified the entire lawsuit, the relevant court misunderstood the law and issued certificates to A multiple times stating that the ruling was finalized. Additionally, the local government sent A a divorce registration notice based on the premise that the divorce was finalized. The commission concluded that A was in a situation where she could reasonably misunderstand that she and B were divorced, and it was difficult to hold her fully responsible for not proceeding with the inheritance renunciation. (건보공단은 A씨가 상속 포기를 하지 않았으므로 상속인으로서 손해배상 책임을 져야 한다는 의견을 냈다. 그러나 권익위가 조사해 보니, B씨 사망으로 소송 전체가 없던 일이 됐음에도 관할 법원이 법리를 오해해 A씨에게 ‘판결이 확정됐다’는 내용으로 여러 차례 증명서를 발급했고, 관할 지방자치단체도 A씨에게 이혼이 확정됐다는 것을 전제로 이혼 신고 안내문을 발송한 것으로 드러났다. 권익위는 A씨가 B씨와 이혼한 것이라고 오해할 만한 상황이었고, 상속 포기 절차를 진행하지 않은 것에 대해 A씨에게 전적으로 책임이 있다고 보기 어려웠다고 판단했다.)

Consequently, the commission expressed its opinion that the NHIS should cancel the claim for recourse. (이에 따라 권익위는 건보공단에 구상금 청구를 취소하라는 의견을 표명했다.)

Min Seong-sim, director of the commission’s Grievance Handling Bureau, stated, “The health insurance system is the most basic social safety net provided by the national community to its citizens. Interpreting regulations favorably for the NHIS and unfavorably for beneficiaries solely to reduce insurance finances or secure funds, regarding the burden of insurance benefit costs, is unreasonable.” He added, “Before the NHIS exercises its right of recourse, a process of examining specific validity according to individual cases is necessary.” (권익위 민성심 고충처리국장은 “건강보험 제도는 국가 공동체가 국민에게 제공하는 가장 기본적인 사회 안전망으로, 보험 급여 비용 부담 문제에 대해 보험 재정 절감이나 확보만을 위해 건보공단에는 유리하고 수급자에게는 불리하게 규정을 해석하는 것은 불합리하다”며 “건보공단이 구상권을 행사하기 전에 개별 사안에 따라 구체적인 타당성을 따져보는 과정이 필요하다”고 했다.)

item.title: President Lee: "Allocation of Corporate Operating Profits is Not a Subject of Labor Disputes" (李대통령 “기업 영업이익 배분, 노동쟁의 대상 아니다”)
item.description:
President Lee: "Allocation of Corporate Operating Profits is Not a Subject of Labor Disputes" (李대통령 “기업 영업이익 배분, 노동쟁의 대상 아니다”)

President Lee Jae-myung stated on the 21st regarding the recent string of demands by corporate unions for "an N% share of operating profits": "Is the issue of allocating a certain percentage of operating profits a subject for labor disputes? I think the side saying it isn't has the stronger case." (이재명 대통령은 21일 최근 각 기업 노조가 ‘영업이익 N% 배분’을 잇따라 요구하는 데 대해 “영업이익의 일정 비율을 배분하는 문제가 노동 쟁의의 대상이 되느냐”며 “저는 아닌 쪽이 더 높다고 생각이 된다”고 말했다.)

During a cabinet meeting held at the Blue House that morning, President Lee made this remark, noting that the scope of labor disputes "seems to be expanding too broadly." His point was that it is problematic for unions to demand "negotiations" by claiming that areas determined by corporate management decisions fall under labor disputes. (이 대통령은 이날 오전 청와대에서 열린 국무회의에서 노동 쟁의의 대상이 “너무 광범위하게 확장되는 것 같다”며 이같이 말했다. 기업의 경영 판단에 따라 결정할 영역까지 노조가 쟁의 대상이라며 ‘협의’를 요구하는 것은 문제가 있다는 취지다.)

This comment from President Lee came in relation to recent developments where Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix decided to build semiconductor fabs on the site of the "Gwangju Military Airfield," which elicited negative reactions from Samsung Electronics' union. (이 대통령의 이 같은 언급은 최근 ‘광주 군공항’ 부지에 삼성전자와 SK하이닉스가 반도체 팹(fab·공장)을 건설하기로 한 데 대해, 삼성전자 노조에서 부정적 반응이 나오는 상황과 관련해 나왔다.)

President Lee said, "When it was announced that a semiconductor plant would be built at the Gwangju military airfield, the existing union argued that 'this is a subject for labor-management negotiations or labor disputes.' In extreme terms, there were statements that could be understood as meaning, 'If you don't agree, don't go—you can't go.' The public is astounded." (이 대통령은 “광주 군 공항에 반도체 공장을 만든다고 하니까 기존 노조에서 ‘이것은 노사 협상 대상이다, 노동 쟁의 대상이 된다’ 이렇게 주장하면서, 극단적으로는 ‘동의 안 하면 가지 마라, 못 간다’ 이런 취지로 이해할 수 있을 정도로 얘기가 나오고 있다”며 “국민들이 깜짝 놀라고 있다”고 했다.)

President Lee questioned, "Can this really be a subject for an individual union to wage labor disputes or strikes against the company?" He added, "It seems they are claiming it's a labor dispute because building a plant in Gwangju raises concerns like 'I might get transferred (to Gwangju).' If you go by that logic, there is no exercise of management rights by any company that wouldn't be related." (이 대통령은 “이게 과연 개별 노조가 회사와 노동쟁의나 파업 등 투쟁의 대상이 될 수 있느냐”며 “광주 공장을 지으면 ‘내가 혹시 (광주로) 전보될 수 있다’는 것 때문에 노동쟁의 대상이라고 하는 것 같은데, 그렇게 따지면 모든 회사의 경영권 행사가 관련이 없는 게 있을 수 없다”고 했다.)

President Lee urged the Ministry of Employment and Labor to step in and set standards, asking, "If you expand (the scope of labor disputes) like this, will there be an end?" He also remarked, "They are making absurd claims." (이 대통령은 고용노동부가 나서서 기준을 정해야 한다면서 “이런 식으로 (노동 쟁의 범위를) 확장하면 끝이 있나”라며 “터무니 없는 주장을 한다”고도 했다.)

President Lee said, "In the end, it seems necessary to establish some standard," and "Providing such a standard is also the government's role." He advised that since not all issues can be resolved through "legislation," the administration should take proactive action in areas where it can set its own standards, such as through enforcement decrees or presidential decrees. (이 대통령은 “결국 이런 건 일정한 기준을 정해줘야 할 것 같다”며 “그런 기준을 제공하는 것도 정부의 역할”이라고 했다. 이 대통령은 모든 문제를 ‘입법’으로 해결할 수는 없는 만큼, 시행령이나 대통령령 등 행정부가 자체적으로 기준을 제시할 수 있는 영역에서 적극 행정에 나서라고 당부했다.)

item.title: [Breaking News] 'Comprehensive Special Counsel Extension Act' Passes in Plenary Session Led by Opposition Party ([속보] ‘종합특검 연장법’ 與 주도 본회의 통과)
item.description:
[Breaking News] 'Comprehensive Special Counsel Extension Act' Passes in Plenary Session Led by Opposition Party ([속보] ‘종합특검 연장법’ 與 주도 본회의 통과)

A bill to extend the investigation period of the second comprehensive special counsel passed the National Assembly plenary session on the 21st, led by the Democratic Party of Korea. The People Power Party initiated a filibuster, claiming it was "an extension of a public security-oriented political situation to suppress and oppress the opposition party," but the Democratic Party, leveraging its majority, forcibly ended the filibuster and pushed through the bill. (2차 종합 특검의 수사 기간을 연장하는 법안이 21일 더불어민주당 주도로 국회 본회의를 통과했다. 국민의힘은 “야당을 옥죄고 탄압하기 위한 공안 정국의 연장”이라며 필리버스터(무제한 토론)에 나섰지만, 민주당은 다수 의석을 바탕으로 필리버스터를 강제 종결한 뒤 법안 처리를 밀어붙였다.)

The Democratic Party put the second comprehensive special counsel bill to a vote at the plenary session that day. With the People Power Party boycotting the vote, the bill passed with 173 votes in favor out of 173 present. (민주당은 이날 본회의에서 2차 종합 특검 법안을 표결에 부쳤다. 국민의힘이 표결에 불참한 가운데 법안은 재석 173명 중 찬성 173명으로 통과했다.)

The amendment extends the investigation period of the second comprehensive special counsel by an additional 30 days. With the passage of the bill, the special counsel investigation period, originally scheduled to end on the 24th, will be extended to the 23rd of next month. The bill also includes adding 'obstruction of audits' by public officials to the scope of the special counsel's investigation and expanding the number of public officials dispatched to the special counsel from 130 to 150. Additionally, it includes provisions to designate special investigators with attorney licenses as prosecutors for maintaining indictments, allowing them to handle the prosecution of cases indicted by the special counsel. (개정안은 2차 종합 특검의 수사 기간을 추가로 30일 늘리는 내용이다. 법안 통과에 따라 오는 24일 종료 예정이었던 특검 수사 기간은 내달 23일로 늘어나게 됐다. 법안에는 특검 수사 대상에 공무원의 ‘감사 방해’ 행위를 추가하고, 특검 파견 공무원 수를 130명에서 150명으로 확대하는 내용도 담겼다. 또 변호사 자격증이 있는 특별수사관을 공소유지 변호사로 지정해 특검 기소 사건의 공소를 맡길 수 있게 하는 내용도 포함됐다.)

Initially, the Rebuilding Korea Party had hinted at the possibility of not cooperating with the Democratic Party's termination of the filibuster, but ahead of the vote to end it, they changed their stance and agreed to participate in the vote after a meeting with the Democratic Party. (당초 조국혁신당은 민주당의 필리버스터 종결에 협조하지 않을 가능성을 내비쳤지만, 종결 표결 직전 민주당과 회동에서 표결에 동참하겠다고 입장을 바꿨다.)

The government is expected to promulgate the revised special counsel act at a Cabinet meeting today. Under current law, the revised special counsel act must be promulgated today to allow for the extension of the special counsel investigation period. (정부는 이날 국무회의에서 특검법 개정안을 공포할 전망이다. 현행법상 이날 특검법 개정안이 공포돼야 특검 수사 기한 연장이 가능하다.)

item.title: People Power Party Returns to Parliamentary Organization... To Elect Opposition-Quota Standing Committee Chairs on the 23rd (국민의힘, 원구성 복귀…23일 野 몫 상임위원장 선출)
item.description:
People Power Party Returns to Parliamentary Organization... To Elect Opposition-Quota Standing Committee Chairs on the 23rd (국민의힘, 원구성 복귀…23일 野 몫 상임위원장 선출)

The People Power Party held a general meeting of lawmakers on the 21st, ratifying the procedure for recommending the so-called 'Election Commission Special Counsel' agreed upon by the ruling and opposition parties, and decided to begin the process of returning to organizing the National Assembly. This comes about three weeks after boycotting parliamentary schedules on the 30th of last month in protest of the Democratic Party of Korea's unilateral assignment of standing committee positions. (국민의힘이 21일 의원총회를 열고 여야가 합의한 이른바 ‘선관위 특검’ 추천 절차를 추인하고 국회 원 구성 복귀 절차에 들어가기로 했다. 지난달 30일 더불어민주당의 일방적 상임위 배정에 반발해 국회 일정을 보이콧한 지 약 3주 만이다.)

People Power Party floor leader Jeong Jeom-sik met with reporters after the general meeting held at the National Assembly that afternoon and stated, "At today's general meeting, we ratified the ruling-opposition agreement on the recommendation procedure for the special counsel related to the so-called 'Right to Vote Infringement Special Counsel Act'," adding, "We still cannot accept the Democratic Party's behavior of unilaterally taking over the Legislation and Judiciary Committee, but there are various pending issues in each standing committee, such as the amendment to the Criminal Procedure Act, so we have decided to return to the Assembly." (국민의힘 정점식 원내대표는 이날 오후 국회에서 열린 의총 이후 기자들과 만나 “오늘 의원총회에서 소위 ‘참정권 침해 특검법’과 관련한 특검 추천 절차에 대한 여야 합의를 추인했다”며 “법사위를 일방적으로 가져간 민주당의 행태는 여전히 수긍하지 못하지만, 형사소송법 개정안 등 각 상임위의 다양한 현안이 있어 일단 국회에 복귀하기로 했다”고 밝혔다 .)

Accordingly, the People Power Party begins its internal election process for standing committee chairs from today. Subsequently, the ruling and opposition parties plan to finalize the election process for the remaining seven standing committee chairs through a plenary session on the 23rd. The Democratic Party had previously forcibly assigned the chairs of seven standing committees—Foreign Affairs and Unification, Health and Welfare, Trade, Industry and Energy and SMEs and Startups, Education, Land, Infrastructure and Transport, Gender Equality and Family, and Information—to the People Power Party. (이에 따라 국민의힘은 이날부터 상임위원장 당내 선거 절차에 돌입한다. 이후 여야는 23일 본회의를 통해 나머지 7곳의 상임위원장 선출 절차를 마무리할 계획이다. 민주당은 앞서 외교통일·보건복지·산업통상자원중소벤처기업·교육·국토교통·성평등가족·정보 등 7개 상임위원장을 국민의힘 몫으로 강제 배정했다.)

At the general meeting, the People Power Party also ratified the 'Election Commission Special Counsel' recommendation procedure agreed upon that morning by the leadership of the ruling and opposition parties. This involves agreeing to introduce a special counsel to investigate incidents such as the shortage of ballots for the June 3 local elections. The contentious issue of the power to recommend the special counsel was decided to be handled through a National Recommendation Committee, composed of three members each selected by the ruling and opposition parties. (국민의힘은 의총에서 이날 오전 여야 원내 지도부가 합의한 ‘선관위 특검’ 추천 절차도 추인했다. 6·3 지방선거 투표용지 부족 사태 등을 수사하는 특별검사 도입에 합의하는 내용이다. 쟁점이었던 특검 추천권은 여야가 3명씩 선정한 국민추천위원회를 통해 추천하기로 했다.)

According to the agreement, to recommend the special counsel, the ruling and opposition parties will each recommend three members to form the National Recommendation Committee. The National Recommendation Committee will receive six candidates (three each) from the Korean Bar Association and the Korean Association of Law Schools. From these, two candidates will be recommended to the president through an agreement between the ruling and opposition parties. The president will then appoint one of the two as the special counsel. (합의안에 따르면 특검 추천을 위해 여야는 3명씩 추천해 국민추천위를 꾸리기로 했다. 국민추천위는 대한변호사협회와 법학전문대학원협의회로부터 각 3명씩 6명의 후보를 추천받고, 그중 여야 합의로 2인을 대통령에게 추천한다. 대통령이 2명 중 1명을 특검으로 임명하게 된다.)

At the National Assembly general meeting that day, People Power Party floor leader Jeong Jeom-sik said, "As someone who has demanded an opposition-proposed special counsel, it is inevitable to feel some regret," while adding, "We have sufficiently secured a special counsel recommendation process that guarantees objectivity and fairness." Although an agreement was reached on the recommendation method for the special counsel that day, further consultations remain on the scope of the investigation and the duration of activities. <<>> (정점식 국민의힘 원내대표는 이날 국회 의원총회에서 “야당 추천 특검을 요구해 온 입장에서 아쉬움이 없을 수는 없다”면서도 “객관성과 공정성을 담보할 특검 추천 절차는 충분히 확보했다”고 했다. 이날 특검 추천 방식엔 합의를 했지만 수사 범위, 활동 기간 등을 통해 추가 협의가 남아 있다.)

item.title: Public servants could work unlimited overtime as 'overtime cap' is abolished (공무원 무제한 근무 가능해진다… ‘초과근무 상한제’ 폐지)
item.description:
Public servants could work unlimited overtime as 'overtime cap' is abolished (공무원 무제한 근무 가능해진다… ‘초과근무 상한제’ 폐지)

The government has decided to abolish the daily cap on overtime work for public servants and effectively allow unlimited overtime on a monthly basis as well. (정부가 공무원 초과 근무(시간 외 근무) 일 상한제를 폐지하고, 월 단위로도 사실상 무제한으로 초과 근무를 허용하기로 했다.)

The Ministry of Personnel Management and the Ministry of the Interior and Safety announced on the 21st that they would pre-announce revisions to the 'Regulations on Allowances for Public Officials' and the 'Regulations on Allowances for Local Public Officials' containing such content. The amendments will take effect after review by the Ministry of Legislation, deliberation by the Deputy Ministers' Meeting and the Cabinet Meeting, and approval by the President. The Ministry of Personnel Management and the Ministry of the Interior and Safety also decided to revise the related 'Guidelines for Public Official Pay and Duties'. (인사혁신처와 행정안전부는 21일 이 같은 내용을 담은 ‘공무원 수당 등에 관한 규정’과 ‘지방공무원 수당 등에 관한 규정’ 개정안을 입법 예고한다고 밝혔다. 개정안은 법제처 심사와 차관회의·국무회의 심의, 대통령 재가를 거쳐 시행된다. 인사처와 행안부는 관련된 ‘공무원 보수 등의 업무 지침’도 개정하기로 했다.)

The Labor Standards Act does not apply to public servants, and therefore the 'maximum 52-hour workweek system' under the Labor Standards Act does not apply either. However, the regulations on public servant allowances have limited overtime pay to a maximum of 4 hours per day, effectively functioning as a de facto cap on working hours. (공무원에게는 근로기준법이 적용되지 않으며, 따라서 근로기준법의 ‘주 최대 52시간 근무제’도 적용되지 않는다. 그러나 공무원 수당 규정이 초과 근무를 한 공무원에게 수당을 하루에 최대 4시간 치만 줄 수 있게 하고 있어, 이것이 실질적인 근무 시간 상한제 역할을 해왔다.)

The government has decided to completely abolish the daily overtime cap and pay allowances in proportion to the actual overtime hours worked by public servants. (정부는 초과근무 1일 상한을 아예 폐지하고, 공무원이 실제로 한 초과 근무 시간에 비례해서 수당을 주기로 했다.)

Currently, overtime is limited to 57 hours per month, but the government has decided to effectively abolish this cap as well. Currently, the monthly overtime cap can be increased to 100 hours only with prior approval from the head of the affiliated agency in cases such as responding to urgent issues. Going forward, the monthly overtime cap can be eliminated with just approval from a director or bureau chief, rather than the head of the affiliated agency. (현재는 한 달에 초과근무를 57시간까지만 할 수 있게 돼 있는데, 정부는 이 상한도 사실상 폐지하기로 했다. 현재는 긴급한 현안에 대응해야 하는 등의 사유가 있을 때만 소속 기관장의 사전 결재 후 초과근무 월 상한을 100시간으로 늘릴 수 있게 돼 있는데, 앞으로는 소속 기관장이 아닌 실·국장급의 결재만 있어도 초과근무 월 상한을 없앨 수 있게 하기로 했다.)

The government also decided that Grade 4 public servants who are not department heads are currently classified as managerial staff and receive 'management duty allowances' instead of overtime pay. However, going forward, if they work more than 25 hours of overtime per month, they will receive an 'overtime compensation allowance' proportional to the excess hours. (정부는 또 부서장이 아닌 4급 공무원은 현재는 관리직으로 분류돼 ‘관리 업무 수당’을 받는 대신 시간 외 근무 수당을 받지 못하지만, 앞으로는 초과근무를 월 25시간 넘게 한 경우에는 초과분에 비례해서 ‘초과근무 보전 수당’을 주기로 했다.)

Instead of allowing unlimited overtime, the government decided to strengthen management, supervision, and sanctions to prevent acts of claiming allowances without actually working overtime. First, an electronic personnel management system will be applied to all public servants working overtime, requiring them to periodically confirm online that they are working overtime at set intervals. In addition, a function to manage the total overtime hours of affiliated public servants will be introduced into the personnel management systems of local governments. Those who fraudulently receive overtime-related allowances two or more times or receive over 500,000 won fraudulently will face mandatory disciplinary action, separate from the recovery of the allowances. (정부는 무제한 초과근무를 허용하는 대신, 초과근무를 하지 않고 초과근무를 한 것처럼 꾸며 수당을 받아가는 행위를 막기 위한 관리·감독과 제재를 강화하기로 했다. 먼저, 초과근무를 하는 전 공무원에게 전자 인사 관리 시스템을 적용해, 초과근무를 하는 동안 일정 시간 간격으로 자신이 초과근무를 하고 있음을 온라인으로 확인하도록 할 계획이다. 또 지방자치단체의 인사 관리 시스템에도 소속 공무원들의 초과근무 총량 관리 기능을 도입하기로 했다. 초과근무 관련 수당을 2회 이상 부정 수령하거나 50만원 이상 부정 수령한 경우에는 수당을 회수하는 것과 별개로 반드시 징계하기로 했다.)

The government's overhaul of the overtime system for public servants follows President Lee Jae-myung's directive during a meeting of senior secretaries and aides at the presidential office on April 7. At the time, President Lee stated, "It is strange that people who don't need to work overtime do so unnecessarily, while those who need to work more aren't recognized for it," adding, "Let those who need to work more do so, and ensure proper management and supervision." (정부가 이렇게 공무원 초과근무 관련 제도를 개편하는 것은 이재명 대통령이 지난 4월 7일 청와대 수석·보좌관 회의에서 제도 개편을 지시한 데 따른 것이다. 당시 이 대통령은 “안 해도 되는 사람들이 쓸데없이 초과근무하고, 해야 하는 사람은 그 이상 일하면서 (초과근무로) 인정 못 받는 게 이상하다”며 “필요한 사람이 더 일하게 하고, 관리·감독을 잘하면 된다”고 했다.)

Minister of Personnel Management Choi Dong-seok said, "This revision is not about treating long working hours as a given, but about providing fair compensation for unavoidable hours worked," adding, "We will strengthen management of fraudulent claims as we make compensation more realistic." (최동석 인사처장은 “이번 개정은 장시간 근무를 당연하게 여기자는 것이 아니라, 불가피하게 일한 시간에 대해서는 합당하게 보상하려는 것”이라며 “보상을 현실화하는 만큼, 부정 수령 관리도 함께 강화하겠다”고 했다.)

item.title: President Lee: "If They Want to Indict, They Will... Third-Party Bribery Charges Must Be Resolved Somehow" (李대통령 “걸면 걸린다…제3자 뇌물죄, 어떻게든 정리해야”)
item.description:
President Lee: "If They Want to Indict, They Will... Third-Party Bribery Charges Must Be Resolved Somehow" (李대통령 “걸면 걸린다…제3자 뇌물죄, 어떻게든 정리해야”)

President Lee Jae-myung stated on the 21st, "If they insist on indicting, they will find a way," signaling the need for a review of the legal application of third-party bribery charges. President Lee has been indicted on charges of accepting third-party bribes in the case of remittances to North Korea and the Seongnam FC case, but his first trial has been suspended since he took office. <<> During a cabinet meeting presided over at the presidential office that day, President Lee said, "The current prosecution's operation of the third-party bribery law holds that if there is a connection to official duties, even donations to a third party or public interest organization are all considered guilty." <<> These remarks came as President Lee was receiving a report on 'Plans to Revitalize Corporate Social Contribution Activities.' When Unification Minister Jeong Dong-young cited as a model case an alternative school for North Korean-background youth receiving 6 billion won from Hyundai Motor Group to build new educational facilities, President Lee commented, "That could potentially fall under third-party bribery," adding, "If various ministries communicate with companies even slightly related to their affairs and encourage them to donate to third-party public interest organizations, under the current concept, that too becomes third-party bribery." <<> He then said, "Operating the penal system for political purposes has led us to this point," and stressed, "This must be resolved somehow." In response, Vice Minister of Justice Lee Jin-soo noted, "There have been past cases where the prosecution indicted based on such third-party bribery charges," but added, "However, when legal grounds exist, such as a specific company building a library and donating books to a juvenile detention center, the government is in a state of receiving donations." <<> President Lee countered, "That's fine when the government receives donations, but aren't they also raising issues with private-sector donations now?" When Vice Minister Lee explained, "The third-party bribery charge does require an 'improper solicitation' as a condition," President Lee retorted, "Isn't the current precedent that if there's a connection, it's deemed an improper solicitation?" <<> Vice Minister Lee replied, "It seems true that this interpretation creates various practical burdens." President Lee concluded, "If they want to indict, they'll find a way. Even with a legal basis, they'll still do it. At some point, we need to set guidelines on this issue." <<> (이재명 대통령은 21일 “굳이 걸면 다 걸린다”며 제3자 뇌물죄 법률 운용에 대한 재검토가 필요하다는 뜻을 밝혔다. 이 대통령은 대북 송금 사건과 성남FC 사건에서 제3자 뇌물 수수 혐의로 기소됐지만, 취임 후 1심 재판이 중단된 상태다.)

item.title: Jung Jeom-sik and Lee Jun-seok Meet: "Consensus on Cooperation Over Abolition of Supplementary Investigation Rights" (정점식, 이준석 회동 “보완수사권 폐지 등 협조 공감대”)
item.description:
Jung Jeom-sik and Lee Jun-seok Meet: "Consensus on Cooperation Over Abolition of Supplementary Investigation Rights" (정점식, 이준석 회동 “보완수사권 폐지 등 협조 공감대”)

Jung Jeom-sik, the floor leader of the People Power Party, and Lee Jun-seok, the leader of the Reform Party, met on the 21st to discuss current issues such as the abolition of the prosecution's supplementary investigation rights and a special counsel investigation into the National Election Commission. Both sides stated that they did not address matters related to the merger of the People Power Party and the Reform Party. (정점식 국민의힘 원내대표와 이준석 개혁신당 대표가 21일 만나 검찰 보완수사권 폐지, 중앙선거관리위원회(선관위) 특검 등 현안에 대해 논의했다. 양측은 다만 국민의힘과 개혁신당의 합당과 관련해선 언급하지 않았다고 밝혔다.)

Floor Leader Jung, Leader Lee, Kim Seung-su, the senior deputy floor leader of the People Power Party, and Cheon Ha-ram, the floor leader of the Reform Party, held a luncheon meeting at a restaurant in Yeouido, Seoul. Afterwards, Senior Deputy Floor Leader Kim told reporters, "We discussed the general situation in the National Assembly and shared opinions on the Democratic Party of Korea and the government's various unreasonable policy pushes, including the abolition of supplementary investigation rights." Leader Lee also told reporters after the meeting, "We discussed common tasks for the opposition, such as the supplementary investigation rights issue, and agreed to consult and cooperate where possible." It was also reported that both sides exchanged views on how to handle the recount of ballots stored at the Seoul Jamsil Olympic Park. (정 원내대표와 이 대표, 국민의힘 김승수 원내수석, 개혁신당 천하람 원내대표는 이날 서울 여의도의 한 식당에서 오찬 회동을 했다. 이후 김 원내수석은 기자들과 만나 “일반적인 국회 상황에 대해 얘기하고, 보완수사권 폐지 등 더불어민주당이나 정부의 여러 가지 무리한 정책 추진에 대해 의견을 공유했다”고 했다. 이 대표도 회동 후 기자들과 만나 “보완수사권 문제 등 야권의 공통 과제들에 대해 협의할 게 있으면 협의하고 같이할 수 있으면 같이 하자고 얘기했다”고 했다. 양측은 서울 잠실 올림픽공원에 보관된 투표지의 재검표를 어떻게 할지에 대해서도 의견을 나눈 것으로 전해졌다.)

The luncheon meeting is said to have been proposed by Floor Leader Jung. After taking office on the 15th of last month, he had previously met with Leader Lee to discuss strategies for opposing the government. Senior Deputy Floor Leader Kim, however, said regarding merger discussions, "Not at all," adding, "It was a meal for camaraderie, so there was no talk about what the two parties should do." (이번 오찬 회동은 정 원내대표의 제안으로 성사된 것으로 전해졌다. 정 원내대표는 지난달 15일 취임 직후 이 대표를 만나 대여 투쟁 방안 등을 논의했었다. 김 원내수석은 다만 합당 논의에 대해선 “전혀”라며 “친목 차원의 식사였기 때문에 두 당이 어떻게 하자 이런 얘기는 없었다”고 했다.)

item.title: [Breaking News] ‘Comprehensive Special Counsel Extension Act’ Approved at Cabinet Meeting… Takes Effect Immediately Upon Promulgation ([속보] ‘종합특검 연장법’ 국무회의 의결… 공포 즉시 발효)
item.description:
[Breaking News] ‘Comprehensive Special Counsel Extension Act’ Approved at Cabinet Meeting… Takes Effect Immediately Upon Promulgation ([속보] ‘종합특검 연장법’ 국무회의 의결… 공포 즉시 발효)

The government decided on the 21st to promulgate a bill as law that extends the investigation period, scope, and personnel of the second comprehensive special counsel. (정부가 21일 2차 종합 특검의 수사 기간과 범위, 인력을 확대하는 법안을 법률로 공포하는 안건을 의결했다.)

The government convened a Cabinet meeting presided over by Prime Minister Han Seong-suk at the Government Complex in Seoul at 5 PM on the same day, proposed and approved the agenda to promulgate the amendment to the second comprehensive special counsel act as law. This came about one hour after the Democratic Party of Korea forced the end of the People Power Party’s filibuster (unlimited debate) in a plenary session of the National Assembly and processed the bill. (정부는 이날 오후 5시 정부서울청사에서 한성숙 국무총리 주재로 국무회의를 열어, 2차 종합 특검법 개정안을 법률로 공포하는 안건을 상정해 의결했다. 더불어민주당이 이날 국회 본회의에서 국민의힘의 필리버스터(무제한 토론)를 강제 종결시키고 법안을 처리한 지 약 1시간 만이다.)

The amendment extends the investigation period of the second comprehensive special counsel, which was set to conclude on the 24th, by an additional 30 days. The amendment also includes adding 'obstruction of audit and inspection' by public officials to the scope of the special counsel investigation, and expanding the number of public officials dispatched to the special counsel from 130 to 150. Additionally, it includes provisions that allow special investigators with lawyer licenses to be designated as prosecutors for maintaining prosecution, enabling them to handle the prosecution of cases indicted by the special counsel. (개정안은 오는 24일 종료될 예정이었던 2차 종합 특검의 수사 기간을 30일 더 늘리는 내용이다. 개정안에는 특검 수사 대상에 공무원의 ‘감사 방해’ 행위를 추가하고, 특검에 파견되는 공무원의 수를 130명에서 150명으로 확대하는 내용도 담겼다. 또 변호사 자격증이 있는 특별수사관을 공소 유지 변호사로 지정해, 특검이 기소한 사건의 공소를 맡길 수 있게 하는 내용도 포함됐다.)

The promulgation of the second comprehensive special counsel act amendment will take effect immediately as law once President Lee Jae-myung approves it, following the process of publication in the official gazette. (2차 종합 특검법 개정안 공포안은 이재명 대통령이 재가하면 관보 게재 절차를 거쳐 공포되고, 곧바로 법률로서 효력이 발생한다.)

item.title: Vice Foreign Minister Urges International Red Cross to Cooperate in Respecting the Will of North Korean Prisoners in Ukraine (외교차관, 국제적십자에 ‘우크라 北포로 의사존중’ 협력 당부)
item.description:
Vice Foreign Minister Urges International Red Cross to Cooperate in Respecting the Will of North Korean Prisoners in Ukraine (외교차관, 국제적십자에 ‘우크라 北포로 의사존중’ 협력 당부)

South Korea’s Second Vice Foreign Minister Kim Jin-ah met on the 21st with Pierre Krähenbühl, visiting Secretary-General of the International Committee of the Red Cross (ICRC), and discussed ways to enhance cooperation in responding to humanitarian crises, the Foreign Ministry announced. (김진아 외교부 2차관은 방한 중인 피에르 크랜뷜 국제적십자위원회(ICRC) 사무총장을 21일 면담하고 인도적 위기 대응을 위한 협력 증진 방안을 논의했다고 외교부가 밝혔다.)

During the meeting, Vice Minister Kim stated that North Korean soldiers taken as prisoners of war in Ukraine are South Korean nationals under the constitution, and that if they wish to come to South Korea, the government will accept all of them. (김 차관은 면담에서 우크라이나 내에 있는 북한군 포로들은 헌법상 한국 국민이고 이들이 한국행을 희망할 경우 우리 정부는 이를 전원 수용할 것이라고 말했다.)

She further requested the ICRC’s active cooperation in ensuring that the prisoners’ free will is respected, in accordance with the principle of international law prohibiting the forced repatriation of prisoners of war. (이어 국제법상 전쟁포로의 강제송환 금지 원칙에 따라 이들의 자유의사가 존중될 수 있도록 ICRC 측의 적극적인 협력을 당부했다.)

Vice Minister Kim evaluated the ICRC’s ongoing efforts to strengthen compliance with international humanitarian law, its humanitarian crisis response activities, and its role as a neutral mediator in armed conflicts, amid the global spread of conflicts and disasters. (김 차관은 세계적으로 분쟁 및 재난이 확산하고 있는 가운데 ICRC가 수행 중인 국제인도법 준수 강화 활동, 인도적 위기 대응 활동, 무력 충돌 상황에서 중립적 중재자로서의 역할을 평가했다.)

She also explained that the government, under the vision of a "Global Pivotal State," has been playing a role as a major donor in the humanitarian aid sector, and said it will continue to cooperate with the ICRC to resolve humanitarian crises in various regions. (또 정부가 글로벌 책임강국 비전하에 인도 지원 분야에서 주요 공여국으로서의 역할을 수행해오고 있음을 설명하고, 각지의 인도적 위기 해소를 위해 ICRC와 지속해 협력해 나갈 것이라고 했다.)

Secretary-General Krähenbühl expressed gratitude for the South Korean government’s financial support and cooperation with the ICRC. (크랜뷜 사무총장은 한국 정부의 ICRC에 대한 재정적 지원과 협력에 사의를 표했다.)

Additionally, noting that violations of international humanitarian law continue in conflict zones, he requested the South Korean government’s participation in the ICRC’s efforts to strengthen international humanitarian law, including the Global Initiative for International Humanitarian Law. (아울러 분쟁 상황에서 국제인도법 위반이 계속되고 있음을 언급하면서 국제인도법 글로벌 구상 등 ICRC 측의 국제인도법 강화 노력에 대한 한국 정부의 참여를 요청했다.)

item.title: Military Protection Zones Including Suseok Airfield and Yongsan Children's Park Lifted or Relaxed… “10 Times the Size of Yeouido” (수색비행장·용산어린이공원 등 軍 보호구역 해제·완화…“여의도 10배 규모”)
item.description:
Military Protection Zones Including Suseok Airfield and Yongsan Children's Park Lifted or Relaxed… “10 Times the Size of Yeouido” (수색비행장·용산어린이공원 등 軍 보호구역 해제·완화…“여의도 10배 규모” )

The Ministry of National Defense announced on the 21st that it will lift or relax military facility protection zones totaling 29.16 million square meters, approximately 10 times the area of Yeouido. This marks the third such measure since the Lee Jae-myung administration took office, following previous actions in September last year and January. <<> According to the Ministry of National Defense, restricted protection zones will be lifted in five locations: Goseong County, Sokcho City, Pyeongtaek City, Goyang City, and Yongsan District (8.628 million square meters). The controlled protection zone in Siheung City (17,000 square meters) will be relaxed to a restricted protection zone, and flight safety zones will be lifted in four areas: Seoul's Mapo and Eunpyeong Districts, Goyang City, and Sejong City (20.515 million square meters). (국방부가 여의도 면적의 약 10배 규모인 2916만㎡의 군사시설 보호구역을 해제·완화한다고 21일 밝혔다. 이재명 정부 출범 이후 군사시설 보호구역 해제·완화는 지난해 9월과 지난 1월 등 3번째다.)

Military facility protection zones are divided into controlled protection zones and restricted protection zones. In controlled protection zones, access and new construction are generally prohibited, while in restricted protection zones, new construction or development is possible after consultation with military units. (국방부에 따르면 제한보호구역이 해제되는 고성군·속초시·평택시·고양시·용산구 등 5곳(862.8만㎡), 통제보호구역에서 제한보호구역으로 완화되는 시흥시(1.7만㎡), 비행안전구역이 해제되는 서울 마포·은평구와 고양시·세종시 4곳(2051.5만㎡) 등이다.)

The restricted protection zone (137,000 square meters) established around Yongsan Children’s Garden, located in the outer boundary area of the Ministry of National Defense, will also be lifted. (군사시설보호구역은 통제보호구역과 제한보호구역으로 나뉜다. 통제보호구역은 출입·건축 신축이 원칙적으로 금지되고, 제한보호구역에서는 군부대와 협의를 거친 후 건축 신축이나 개발이 가능하다.)

Additionally, parts of the flight safety zones at Suseok Airfield and Jochiwon Airfield will be lifted. The Ministry of National Defense plans to change the purpose of Suseok Airfield in Seoul's Mapo and Eunpyeong Districts and Goyang City, Gyeonggi Province, from a support air operations base to a dedicated helicopter operations base, and to proceed with lifting the flight safety zone (19.82 million square meters). The lifting of the flight safety zone in this area is scheduled to align with the amendment of the enforcement decree in the second half of this year. (국방부 경계 외곽지역인 용산어린이정원에 설정된 제한보호구역(13.7만㎡)도 해제하기로 했다.)

For Jochiwon Airfield in the Sejong City area, the flight safety zone (695,000 square meters) for the existing runway will be lifted as part of the integrated relocation project for Jochiwon and Yeon-gi Airfields. (아울러 수색비행장·조치원비행장의 비행안전구역 일부도 해제된다. 국방부는 서울 마포·은평구와 경기 고양시 일대 수색비행장 용도를 기존 지원항공작전기지에서 헬기전용작전기지로 변경하고, 비행안전구역(1982만㎡) 해제를 추진하기로 했다. 이 구역의 비행안전구역 해제는 올해 하반기 시행령 개정에 맞춰 이뤄질 예정이다.)

The protection zones being lifted or relaxed this time will take effect after the official gazette notice on the 22nd. (세종시 일대 조치원비행장은 조치원·연기비행장 통합 이전사업에 따라 기존 활주로에 대한 비행안전구역(69.5만㎡)을 해제한다.)

The topographic maps and detailed lot numbers for the areas where protection zones are lifted or relaxed can be viewed at the relevant local governments and jurisdictional military units, and the status of protection zones applied to each parcel can also be checked through the "Internet Land eum" search. (이번에 해제 또는 완화되는 보호구역은 오는 22일 관보 고시 이후 효력이 발생한다.)

Last month, the Ministry of National Defense announced as part of the "Military Facility Regulation Improvement Measures" that it would raise the civilian control line (CCL) by an average of 2 kilometers and gradually pursue the lifting or relaxation of military facility protection zones totaling 240 times the area of Yeouido. (보호구역 해제·완화 지역의 지형도면과 세부 지번은 해당 지자체와 관할부대에서 열람할 수 있으며, 각 필지에 적용되는 보호구역의 현황은 ‘인터넷 토지e음’ 검색을 통해서도 확인할 수 있다.)

The Ministry of National Defense stated, "We will reasonably adjust the military facility protection zones to improve the lives of residents and develop together with local communities, within the scope that does not interfere with military operations." (지난달 국방부는 ‘군사시설 규제개선 대책’의 일환으로 민간인통제선(민통선)을 평균 2㎞ 올리고, 여의도 면적 240배 규모의 군사시설 보호구역 해제·완화를 점진적으로 추진하겠다고 밝힌 바 있다.)

item.title: Ruling Party Convention Sparks Shincheonji Controversy... Kim Min-seok: "Why No Special Counsel?" Jeong Cheong-rae: "Legal Action Against Fake News" (與 전대 신천지 논란...김민석 “특검 왜 안했나” 정청래 “가짜뉴스 법적조치”)
item.description:
Ruling Party Convention Sparks Shincheonji Controversy... Kim Min-seok: "Why No Special Counsel?" Jeong Cheong-rae: "Legal Action Against Fake News" (與 전대 신천지 논란...김민석 “특검 왜 안했나” 정청래 “가짜뉴스 법적조치”)

Ahead of the Democratic Party of Korea's next party leadership election, Shincheonji has emerged as a political flashpoint. Former lawmaker and frontrunner for the party leadership, Kim Min-seok, has repeatedly raised allegations of Shincheonji's interference in the party convention. Former leader Jeong Cheong-rae, targeting some YouTubers who have linked him to Shincheonji, has taken a hardline stance, stating, "We will take legal action under a zero-tolerance principle." <<> Former lawmaker Kim met with reporters on the 21st after a meeting with the Seoul Metropolitan Council and stated, "The essence of this party convention is to dismantle the triple alliance of anti-Myung (anti-Lee Jae-myung), factionalism, and Shincheonji." Kim added, "Regarding Shincheonji, there will be opportunities to address it step by step," and emphasized, "We need to point out things one by one, such as why a special counsel investigation into Shincheonji hasn't been conducted." This is interpreted as a critique of the current leadership under Jeong Cheong-rae, referencing the failed push for a "Unification Church and Shincheonji special counsel" earlier this year. He also expressed hope that "other candidates will be able to strictly criticize Shincheonji's political interference." <<> Earlier that morning, on MBC Radio's "Kim Jong-bae's Focus," Kim had stated, "Shincheonji is not a metaphor but a reality," adding, "I am looking at the Shincheonji issue very specifically and carefully." <<> Meanwhile, former leader Jeong Cheong-rae, speaking to reporters after the same meeting, dismissed suspicions of Shincheonji's involvement in the party convention, saying, "This has nothing to do with me," and warned, "If there are attempts to tarnish my image with such fake news and false manipulated information, I will take legal action under a zero-tolerance policy." Jeong noted, "I am aware that such fake manipulated news is being spread on YouTube, and I have already taken legal measures. Regardless of status or position, I will apply the strongest legal actions possible. Under the Information and Communications Network Act, they face severe punishment." <<> In response, former leader Jeong counterattacked by digging into Kim Min-seok’s past. Jeong stated, "Four years ago, during the August 18 party convention, Kim attacked President Lee Jae-myung over the local election results in the same way," and added, "Four years ago, he insulted Lee Jae-myung; now, he is attacking Jeong Cheong-rae in the same manner. Let’s stop doing this." (더불어민주당 차기 당대표 선거를 앞두고 신천지가 정국의 뇌관으로 떠오르고 있다. 차기 당권 주자인 김민석 전 총리가 ‘신천지 전당대회 개입설’을 거듭 제기하고 나선 것이다. 정청래 전 대표는 자신의 신천지 연루설을 제기하는 일부 유튜버를 겨냥해 “무관용 원칙으로 법적 조치를 취하겠다”면서 강경 대응에 나섰다.)

item.title: Lee's 1.77 Billion Won Mortgage Controversy... Presidential Office: "Conducted Through Conventional Real Estate Methods" (李 17억7000만원 근저당 논란... 靑 “통상적 방식으로 부동산 통해 이뤄져”)
item.description:
Lee's 1.77 Billion Won Mortgage Controversy... Presidential Office: "Conducted Through Conventional Real Estate Methods" (李 17억7000만원 근저당 논란... 靑 “통상적 방식으로 부동산 통해 이뤄져”)

The Presidential Office stated on the 21st regarding President Lee Jae-myung's home sale that it was "conducted through conventional real estate methods" and that "the mortgage registration was transparently carried out based on a civil agreement between the transaction parties." (청와대는 21일 이재명 대통령의 자택 매매에 대해 “통상적 방식으로 부동산을 통해 이뤄졌다”며 “근저당 설정은 거래 당사자들의 민사상 합의에 따라 투명하게 진행됐다”고 했다.)

The Presidential Office's spokesperson office made this announcement through a media notice on the same day, adding, "We ask for caution regarding claims that deviate from the facts or related reports concerning the disposal of the presidential residence." (청와대 대변인실은 이날 언론 공지를 통해 이같이 밝히며 “대통령 사저 처분과 관련해 사실 관계가 어긋난 주장이나 그에 따른 보도에 유의해달라”고 했다.)

Earlier, it was revealed that President Lee, in the process of selling his apartment in Bundang for 2.9 billion won, transferred ownership and registered a mortgage for 1.77 billion won without receiving the balance payment in full. This sparked criticism that it is detached from the reality of the loan regulations pursued by the current administration. (앞서 이 대통령이 분당 소재 아파트를 29억원에 파는 과정에서 17억7000만원에 달하는 잔금을 받지 않은 상태로 소유권부터 넘기고 근저당을 설정한 사실이 알려지면서 현 정부가 추진한 대출 규제의 현실과 동떨어져 있다는 비판 여론이 쏟아졌다.)

In response, the Presidential Office stated, "The presidential residence was a single home where President Lee and his wife had lived for 28 years. They sold it at a price lower than the market value, giving up expected profits from reconstruction, to demonstrate their commitment to normalizing the real estate market." (이에 대해 청와대는 “대통령 자택은 이 대통령 부부가 28년간 실거주했던 1주택으로, 부동산 시장 정상화의 의지를 보이고자 시세보다도 낮게 재건축으로 기대되는 이익을 포기하고 처분했다”고 했다.)

Regarding the mortgage registration of approximately 1.77 billion won on the property title, it was explained as "a mortgage for the unpaid balance that will be settled by the end of October" and that "the title transfer was made considering the buyer's circumstances." (등기상 17억7000만원 가량의 근저당이 설정된 점에 대해선 “10월 말에 처리될 미지급 잔금에 대한 근저당”이라며 “매수인의 사정을 배려해 등기 이전을 했다”고 설명했다.)

The Presidential Office added, "The designation of the sold property as a leading reconstruction district occurred in November 2024, under the previous Yoon Suk Yeol administration, and at that time, the mayor of Seongnam was also a member of the People Power Party. Therefore, claims of special treatment in the reconstruction designation are nonsense." <<>> (청와대는 “매도 물건의 재건축 선도지구 지정은 전임 윤석열 정부 시절인 2024년 11월이며 당시는 성남시장도 국민의힘 소속이었다”며 “따라서 재건축 지정 특혜 주장은 어불성설”이라고 했다.)

item.title: ASEAN Foreign Ministers' Meeting Opens... Attention on Whether Cho will Hold Talks with Rubio (아세안 외교장관회의 개막... 조현, 루비오와 회담 성사 여부 주목)
item.description:
ASEAN Foreign Ministers' Meeting Opens... Attention on Whether Cho will Hold Talks with Rubio (아세안 외교장관회의 개막... 조현, 루비오와 회담 성사 여부 주목)

The ASEAN (Association of Southeast Asian Nations) Foreign Ministers' Meeting opened on the 21st (local time) in Manila, Philippines, commencing a three-day schedule. South Korean Foreign Minister Cho arrived in Manila on the evening of the same day and will attend ASEAN-related foreign ministers' meetings on the 22nd and 23rd. Amid the re-escalation of the U.S.-Iran conflict, Minister Cho plans to convey a commitment to strengthening cooperation and solidarity with ASEAN, which has been severely impacted by energy supply instability stemming from the Middle East. (아세안(ASEAN·동남아시아국가연합) 외교장관회의가 21일(현지 시각) 필리핀 마닐라에서 개막해 사흘간의 일정에 돌입했다. 조현 외교부 장관은 이날 밤 마닐라에 도착해 22~23일 아세안 관련 외교장관회의에 참석한다. 조 장관은 미국·이란 전쟁이 다시 격화하는 가운데 중동발 에너지 공급 불안으로 큰 타격을 받은 아세안과의 협력 및 결속 강화 의지를 전달할 예정이다.)

According to ASEAN, member states expressed "serious concern" over the resumption of war between the U.S. and Iran in a joint statement issued after the plenary session of the ASEAN Foreign Ministers' Meeting that day, noting that this could further harm trade, food, and energy security in the region. (아세안에 따르면 회원국들은 이날 아세안 외교장관회의 본회의 후 내놓은 공동성명에서 미국과 이란 간 전쟁 재개에 대해 “심각한 우려”를 나타내고 이로 인해 이 지역의 무역·식량·에너지 안보가 더 큰 타격을 받을 수 있다고 밝혔다.)

They stated, "We are deeply concerned that these developments seriously undermine the continued efforts of key mediators and weaken the prospects for a peaceful resolution through dialogue and diplomacy." (이들은 “이런 상황 전개가 주요 중재국들의 지속적인 노력을 심각하게 저해하고 대화와 외교를 통한 평화적 해결 전망을 약화하는 것에 대해 깊이 우려한다”고 했다.)

The foreign ministers also emphasized the importance of maintaining maritime safety and security, upholding freedom of navigation and overflight, and urged the restoration of "safe and uninterrupted passage of ships and aircraft through the Strait of Hormuz." (외교장관들은 또 해상 안전·안보 유지, 항행과 비행의 자유 수호의 중요성을 강조하고 “호르무즈 해협에서 선박과 항공기의 안전하고 방해받지 않는 지속적인 통행”을 회복해야 한다고 촉구했다.)

From the 22nd, Minister Cho will participate in five meetings over two days: the ROK-ASEAN Foreign Ministers' Meeting, the ROK-Mekong Foreign Ministers' Meeting, the ASEAN+3 (South Korea, China, Japan) Foreign Ministers' Meeting, the East Asia Summit (EAS) Foreign Ministers' Meeting, and the ASEAN Regional Forum (ARF). Minister Cho is expected to explain the Lee Jae-myung government's efforts for peaceful coexistence on the Korean Peninsula during the EAS and ARF, which address security strategy issues. (조 장관은 22일부터 이틀간 한·아세안 외교장관회의, 한·메콩 외교장관회의, 아세안+3(한·중·일) 외교장관회의, 동아시아정상회의(EAS) 외교장관회의, 아세안지역안보포럼(ARF) 등 5개 회의체에 참석한다. 조 장관은 안보 전략 문제를 다루는 EAS와 ARF에서 한반도 평화 공존을 위한 이재명 정부의 노력을 설명할 예정이다.)

On the 22nd, Minister Cho will hold a trilateral foreign ministers' meeting with U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio and Japanese Foreign Minister Toshimitsu Motegi. The three top diplomats will reconvene approximately two weeks after their meeting held on the sidelines of the NATO summit in Ankara, Turkey, on the 7th. (조 장관은 22일 마코 루비오 미국 국무장관, 모테기 도시미쓰 일본 외무상과 한·미·일 외교장관 회담을 한다. 3국 외교 수장은 지난 7일 튀르키예 앙카라에서 열린 북대서양조약기구(NATO·나토) 정상회의 계기 회담 이후 약 2주 만에 다시 만나게 된다.)

Minister Cho is also coordinating a separate bilateral meeting with Secretary Rubio, though it has not yet been confirmed. Issues such as U.S. investment in South Korea and the Coupang problem have emerged as pending matters between the two countries. (조 장관은 이와 별도로 루비오 장관과 양자 회담도 조율 중이지만 확정되지 않았다. 한미 간에는 대미 투자와 쿠팡 문제 등이 현안으로 떠올랐다.)

Minister Cho will also hold bilateral foreign ministers' meetings with countries including Australia, Thailand, New Zealand, Brunei, and the Philippines. Bilateral talks with Japan, China, and others are also being coordinated. (조 장관은 또 호주, 태국, 뉴질랜드, 브루나이, 필리핀 등 국가와 양자 외교장관 회담을 한다. 일본, 중국 등과도 양자 외교장관 회담을 조율 중이다.)

item.title: Hacked National Diplomatic Academy Unaware for 10 Months (해킹 당한 국립외교원, 10개월간 몰랐다)
item.description:
It was reported on the 21st that the internal education system of the Korea National Diplomatic Academy (KNDA), under the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, which stores personal information of up to 10,000 individuals including South Korean diplomats and overseas mission staff, was hacked. The Ministry of Foreign Affairs has about 2,500 employees, and it is suspected that the names, positions, and email addresses of most overseas mission personnel, including defense attachés dispatched by the Ministry of National Defense and intelligence officers dispatched by the National Intelligence Service, as well as staff from other ministries, may have been leaked. The perpetrator of the hack has not yet been identified, but it is reported that the possibility of North Korea or China cannot be ruled out. However, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs stated regarding the request for an investigation by an external agency that it is "comprehensively considering" the matter. <<> According to the Ministry of Foreign Affairs on the same day, an outsider infiltrated the server of the KNDA's online education system around May of last year and accessed it frequently for about 10 months until February of this year. This server, which allows Ministry of Foreign Affairs employees and staff from other ministries working at overseas missions to take online courses in languages and basic diplomatic skills, was established in 2022 due to the impact of the COVID-19 pandemic. <<> The server stored approximately 10,000 IDs along with the names, positions, affiliated departments, emails, and encrypted passwords of employees using those IDs. However, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs explained that sensitive information such as resident registration numbers, mobile phone numbers, and addresses was not stored. Although the number of leaked cases has not been confirmed, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs is not ruling out the possibility that all 10,000 records were leaked externally. <<> A diplomatic official stated, "As of now, there is insufficient technical analysis to determine the perpetrator," and added, "We are not ruling out any possibilities, including hacking organizations behind other countries." He also said, "We recognize this as a situation not unrelated to national security." There have been past cases where hacker groups based in North Korea or China attempted attacks on the Ministry of Foreign Affairs' emails and other systems. <<> The Ministry of Foreign Affairs only became aware of the hack in early February this year through a notification from a related agency and subsequently blocked access to the education system. The Ministry stated, "The attackers exploited a 'zero-day vulnerability' that even the software manufacturer was unaware of at the time, and then used normal software permissions, making detection difficult through ordinary methods." This means that the hacker discovered a security flaw unknown to the manufacturer first, leading to delays in detection and response. (우리 외교관과 해외 공관 주재관 등 최대 1만여 명의 개인 정보가 저장된 외교부 산하 국립외교원의 내부 교육 시스템이 해킹당한 것으로 21일 전해졌다. 외교부 직원 수는 약 2500명으로 국방부 파견 무관과 국정원 파견 주재관을 포함한 타 부처 출신까지 해외 공관 근무자 대부분의 이름, 직책, 이메일 주소 등이 유출됐을 가능성이 제기된다. 해킹 주체는 아직 파악되지 않았지만, 북한이나 중국 등일 가능성을 배제할 수 없는 것으로 전해졌다. 그러나 외교부는 외부 기관 수사 의뢰 여부에 대해 “종합적으로 고려 중”이라고 밝혔다.)

item.title: DP Caucus on Prosecution’s Supplementary Investigation Powers: "Abolishing It Would Bring Back Another Jang Yun-gi" "That Was an Exceptional Case" (與 보완수사권 의총… “폐지 땐 장윤기 또 나와” “그건 이례적 사건”)
item.description:
The Democratic Party of Korea held a general meeting of lawmakers on the 21st to hear expert opinions, including those from legal scholars and civic activists, on the prosecution's supplementary investigation powers. The experts were sharply divided between abolition and retention. The party initially planned to pass a bill to completely abolish the prosecution's supplementary investigation powers before the August 17 national convention, but it is undergoing a deliberative process as negative public opinion has grown following the "Jang Yun-gi case." <<> Professor Park Chan-un of Hanyang University Law School, who served as chairman of the advisory committee for the government's prosecution reform task force, stated, "The abuse of prosecutorial power originated from direct investigations, which account for less than 1% of all cases. Abolishing supplementary investigations would risk the handling of the remaining 99% of general criminal cases referred by the police, making it a reform that could endanger them." Attorney Kim Kyu-hyun argued, "If we only separate investigation and prosecution, the police would monopolize investigative authority and the prosecution would monopolize indictment authority. Without supplementary investigation powers, a second or third Jang Yun-gi case could occur." Kim Hye-jung, director of the Korea Sexual Violence Relief Center, emphasized the need for supplementary investigation powers, saying, "Even the 'complete removal of prosecutorial investigation powers' in 2021 made things very difficult for sexual violence victims." <<> In contrast, Professor Yoo Seung-ik of Myongji University's Law Department stated, "The prosecution demands supplementary investigation powers under the pretext of victim protection, but their true intentions don't seem to be about protecting victims." Professor Hwang Moon-gyu of Joongbu University's Police Administration Department said, "Instead of leaving supplementary investigation powers with the prosecution, we should strengthen victim protection support systems." Former police officer-turned-attorney Kang Dong-pil remarked, "The Jang Yun-gi case is an extremely exceptional one," adding, "The alternative to controlling poor police investigations is not the prosecutor's post-hoc direct investigation." <<> However, Democratic Party lawmaker Seo Young-kyo, chairman of the National Assembly's Legislation and Judiciary Committee, appeared on Kim Eo-jun's YouTube channel on the same day and said, "Since the investigation was already removed from the prosecutor's duties when the Prosecution Service Act was created, that is the party's official stance," adding, "We have no intention of granting supplementary investigation powers to prosecutors." <<> Meanwhile, President Lee Jae-myung presided over a Cabinet meeting on the same day and stated, "Our ideals and values are important, but what matters more is the people's lives. No policy or reform can succeed if it is disconnected from the people's lives." This was interpreted as a reminder to the ruling party that public opinion is strongly opposed to the complete abolition of supplementary investigation powers. A senior official at the presidential office told the press on the same day, "It would be best for the ruling party to reach a conclusion on supplementary investigation powers early to reduce unnecessary confusion," adding, "We will respect whatever decision is made." (더불어민주당은 21일 의원총회를 열고 검찰 보완수사권에 대한 법률가, 시민단체 활동가 등 전문가의 찬반 의견을 들었다. 전문가들도 폐지와 존치 의견이 팽팽했다. 민주당은 당초 8·17 전당대회 전 검찰 보완수사권 완전 폐지 법안을 처리하겠다고 했지만 최근 ‘장윤기 사건’을 계기로 부정적 여론이 커지자 숙의 과정을 거치고 있다.)

item.title: Kim Min-seok Raises ‘Shincheonji Convention Intervention’ Allegations… Jung Cheong-rae Says “Fake News” (김민석이 띄운 ‘신천지 전대 개입설’… 정청래 “가짜뉴스”)
item.description:
Former Prime Minister Kim Min-seok, who is running in the Democratic Party of Korea’s leadership election, said on the 21st, “Shincheonji is intervening in the party convention,” adding, “I will reveal evidence soon.” While he did not specify whom the Shincheonji forces are supporting, pro-government YouTubers are spreading claims of “former Representative Jung Cheong-rae’s involvement.” Jung strongly countered, saying, “This has nothing to do with me. I will take zero-tolerance legal action against the spread of fake news.” (더불어민주당 당대표 선거에 출마한 김민석 전 국무총리가 21일 “신천지가 전당대회에 개입하고 있다”며 “조만간 증거를 공개하겠다”고 했다. 신천지 세력이 구체적으로 누구를 지원하고 있는지는 언급하지 않았지만 친여 유튜버들은 ‘정청래 전 대표의 연루설’을 퍼뜨리고 있다. 정 전 대표는 “저하고 전혀 관련 없는 문제다. 가짜 뉴스 유포는 무관용 원칙으로 법적 조치하겠다”며 강력 반발했다.)

On this day, Kim wrote on Facebook, “Shincheonji’s political intervention, dual party membership, and ghost members are a cancer on Korean politics,” and “I formally propose that after the Democratic Party’s August 17 convention, each political party and the National Election Commission reach an agreement to settle and eliminate the dual membership issue with public understanding.” (김 전 총리는 이날 페이스북에 “신천지 정치 개입, 이중 당적, 유령 당원 문제는 한국 정치의 암”이라며 “민주당 8·17 전당대회 이후, 각 정당과 선관위의 합의로 이중 당적 문제를 국민적 양해하에 정리, 청산할 것을 공식 제안한다”고 썼다.)

Kim has been frequently mentioning Shincheonji recently. During his policy speech on the 12th, he said, “I will root out Shincheonji’s election interference,” and on the 19th, he wrote on X (formerly Twitter), “The essence of this convention is a grand battle against disguised anti-Moon, factionalism, and Shincheonji.” At a joint preliminary primary speech on the 20th, he also stated, “We must break the secret triple alliance of anti-Moon forces, factionalists, and Shincheonji.” Since then, pro-Moon YouTubers have been uploading videos claiming, “An event attended by former Representative Jung in the Honam region was hosted by a Shincheonji front organization.” (김 전 총리는 최근 자주 신천지를 언급하고 있다. 지난 12일 정견 발표 때 “신천지의 선거 개입을 발본색원하겠다”고 했고, 지난 19일 엑스(X)에 “이번 전당대회의 본질은 위장한 반명, 분열주의 및 신천지와의 대회전”이라고 썼다. 지난 20일 예비 경선 합동연설회에서도 “반명·분열주의·신천지 3자 비밀 연합을 깨야 한다”고 했다. 이후 친명 유튜버들은 “최근 정 전 대표가 참석한 호남 행사가 신천지 위장 단체가 주최한 행사였다”는 내용의 영상을 잇따라 올리고 있다.)

In a meeting with reporters on the 21st, Kim further said, “We need to address issues like the fact that the Shincheonji special counsel investigation has not proceeded.” This was a reference to how a plan to include not only the Unification Church but also Shincheonji in the scope of a special counsel probe into church-state collusion, pushed during Jung’s tenure as party leader this past January, fell through. When asked in a radio interview that day for evidence of these allegations, Kim replied, “I will speak at an appropriate time.” (김 전 총리는 21일 기자들과 만나서도 “신천지 특검이 진행이 안 된 점 같은 것들을 하나하나 짚어 가야 한다”고 했다. 정 전 대표가 당대표 시절인 지난 1월 정교 유착 의혹 특검 대상에 통일교뿐만 아니라 신천지도 넣는 방안이 추진됐다가 무산된 것을 지적한 것이다. 김 전 총리는 이날 라디오 인터뷰에서 해당 의혹에 대한 근거를 묻는 질문엔 “적절한 시기에 말씀드리겠다”고 했다.)

Former Representative Jung responded, “Do you think such absurd negative campaigning will work?” and added, “I will immediately take legal action. Those who are guilty will be punished at the strongest level possible.” Regarding Kim’s claim that Shincheonji was excluded from the Unification Church special counsel investigation, Jung told reporters, “The party, government, and presidential office coordinated to have the police handle it due to a shortage of prosecutors.” He then said, “This is something that could be quickly verified if checked, but it seems there’s an intention to pin a negative Shincheonji image on me.” Jung’s side announced they had filed a complaint against the YouTuber who raised the Shincheonji involvement allegations. (정 전 대표는 “이런 황당한 네거티브가 먹힐 거라 생각하는가”라며 “바로 법적 조치 들어가겠다. 죄 있는 자는 가장 강력한 수위로 벌받게 하겠다”고 했다. 기자들과 만나 통일교 특검에 신천지가 빠졌다는 김 전 총리 주장에 대해서도 “당정청이 검사가 좀 부족하니 경찰에서 수사하는 걸로 하자고 조율한 것”이라고 했다. 그러면서 “확인해보면 금방 나오는 건데, 저에게 신천지의 부정적인 이미지를 씌우려고 하는 의도가 있는 듯 보인다”고 했다. 정 전 대표 측은 신천지 연루설을 제기한 유튜버를 고발했다고 밝혔다.)

Kim’s references to Shincheonji are aimed at Jung. This is because among the Democratic Party’s support base, Shincheonji is perceived as “a supporting force for the People Power Party.” Especially among pro-Moon supporters, it is often said that “religious groups like Shincheonji systematically intervened to bring down candidate Lee Jae-myung during the 2022 Democratic Party presidential primary.” At the time, when candidate Lee Nak-yon significantly outperformed Lee Jae-myung in the final stages of the primary, Kim Eo-jun raised a conspiracy theory claiming, “100,000 Shincheonji members’ votes infiltrated the Democratic Party primary to help Lee Nak-yon.” A ruling party official commented, “Ahead of this party leadership election, there is a growing number of pro-Moon supporters who claim that the pro-Moon, anti-Lee forces that supported Lee Nak-yon at that time, along with Shincheonji, are backing former Representative Jung.” (김 전 총리의 신천지 언급은 정 전 대표를 향해있다. 민주당 지지층에선 “신천지는 국민의힘 지지 세력”으로 받아들여지고 있기 때문이다. 특히 친명 지지자들 사이에선 “2022년 민주당 대선 후보 경선 때도 이재명 후보를 떨어뜨리기 위해 신천지 등 종교 집단이 조직적으로 개입했다”고들 말하고 있다. 당시 막판 경선에서 이낙연 후보가 이재명 후보를 크게 이기자 김어준씨는 “이낙연을 돕기 위해 신천지 신도 10만명 표가 민주당 경선에 침투했다”는 내용의 음모론을 제기하기도 했다. 여권 관계자는 “이번 당대표 선거를 앞두고 당시 이낙연을 지지했던 친문·반명 및 신천지 세력이 정 전 대표를 밀고 있다고 주장하는 친명 지지층이 늘고 있다”고 했다.)

It is not unrelated to this trend that pro-Moon lawmaker Song Young-gil, also running for party leader, directly targeted Jung recently by saying, “According to polls, the person with the highest approval rating in the People Power Party is Jung Cheong-rae.” Appearing on a YouTube show on the 20th, Song stated, “I wonder if strange people have infiltrated the party. It’s entirely possible that People Power Party supporters have joined and decided that supporting Jung Cheong-rae helps maintain support for their own party.” On the 21st, after meeting with former Daegu Mayor Hong Joon-pyo, Song said, “We shared the regret that if Shincheonji hadn’t intervened in the 2021 People Power Party presidential primary, candidate Hong Joon-pyo would have become the presidential nominee instead of Yoon Suk-yeol.” (당대표 선거에 출마한 친명계 송영길 의원이 최근 정 전 대표를 직격하며 “여론조사를 보면 국민의힘에서 가장 지지도가 높은 사람이 정청래”라고 한 것도 이런 흐름과 무관치 않다. 송 의원은 지난 20일 한 유튜브에 나와 “이상한 사람들이 당에 들어와 있는 게 아닌가 싶다. 얼마든지 국민의힘 지지자들이 들어와 ‘정청래를 지지하는 게 국민의힘 지지 유지에 도움이 된다’고 판단해서 지지할 수 있다”고 했다. 송 의원은 21일에는 홍준표 전 대구시장과 만난 뒤 “지난 2021년 국민의힘 대선 경선에서 신천지 개입이 없었다면 윤석열이 아닌 홍준표 후보가 대선 후보가 됐을 텐데 하는 아쉬움을 나누었다”고 했다.)

In response, a close aide to former Representative Jung remarked, “It seems Kim and Song are collaborating to use Shincheonji to frame Jeong as a Lee Nak-yon-style traitor or someone backed by the People Power Party,” adding, “Jeong, who trusts only the party members and stands alone, won’t be swayed by such attacks.” (이에 대해 정 전 대표 측 관계자는 “김 전 총리와 송 의원이 합작으로 신천지를 띄워 정 전 대표를 이낙연식 사쿠라(배신자), 국민의힘 지원을 받는 자로 몰고 가고 싶은 모양”이라며 “당원만 믿고 가는 정 전 대표는 홀홀단신이라서 이런 공격은 먹히지 않을 것”이라고 했다.)

Kim and Jung are escalating their criticism of each other. During a candidate meeting for the party leadership on this day, Jung brought up remarks Kim made years ago blaming President Lee Jae-myung for the defeat in local elections. This was in response to Kim’s accusation that he is “pro-Moon in name only.” Jung said, “Even though it’s a convention, I wish there wouldn’t be this habit of attacking Lee Jae-myung four years ago, and now attacking Jung Cheong-rae. Such negative tactics should stop.” At the same event, Kim retorted, “Who in South Korea would see me as an anti-Moon factionalist?” He asked, “If remarks like ‘ABC divide-and-conquer’ and ‘certain regime defeat’ aren’t anti-Moon and factionalist, what are they?” This was a jab at both Yoo Shi-min, who made those comments, and Jung for avoiding taking a stance on them. (김 전 총리와 정 전 대표는 서로를 향한 비판 수위를 높이고 있다. 정 전 대표는 이날 당대표 후보 간담회에서 수년 전 김 전 총리가 이재명 대통령에게 지방선거 패배 책임을 돌렸던 발언을 거론했다. 김 전 총리가 자신을 향해 “말로만 친명”이라고 하자 맞대응한 것이다. 정 전 대표는 “전당대회라고 하더라도 습관처럼 4년 전에는 이재명 공격하고, 4년 후에는 정청래 공격하고 이런 네거티브는 안 했으면 좋겠다”고 했다. 김 전 총리는 같은 자리에서 “대한민국 사람이라면 누가 저를 반명 분열주의자로 보겠는가”라며 “‘ABC 갈라치기’ ‘정권 필패’ 발언이 반명이고 분열주의 아니면 뭔가”라고 했다. 해당 발언을 한 유시민씨와 그에 대한 입장 표명을 피한 정 전 대표를 함께 겨냥한 것이다.)

item.title: Ruling and Opposition Parties Agree on Special Counsel for 'Ballot Shortage' at National Election Commission... People Power Party to Return to Parliament (여야 ‘투표용지 부족’ 선관위 특검 합의… 국힘, 국회 복귀하기로)
item.description:
The ruling and opposition parties agreed on the 21st to introduce a special counsel to investigate the ballot shortage incident during the June 3 local elections. Regarding the contentious issue of recommending the special counsel, it was decided that a National Recommendation Committee, composed of three members each from the ruling and opposition parties, would have the authority. The People Power Party, which had been boycotting parliamentary standing committee activities in opposition to the Democratic Party's unilateral allocation of committee seats, decided to return to the National Assembly. (여야가 21일 6·3 지방선거 투표용지 부족 사태 등을 수사하는 특별검사 도입에 합의했다. 쟁점이었던 특검 추천권은 여야가 3명씩 선정해 구성된 국민추천위원회가 갖기로 했다. 더불어민주당의 일방적 상임위원회 배분에 반대하며 국회 상임위 활동을 거부해왔던 국민의힘은 국회에 복귀하기로 했다.)

Democratic Party floor leader Han Byung-do and People Power Party floor leader Chung Jum-sik announced on the morning of the same day that they had agreed on a special counsel bill to uncover the truth behind the election management failures, including the ballot shortage incident, and would handle it during the extraordinary session in July. This comes 48 days after the ballot shortage occurred on June 3. (민주당 한병도 원내대표와 국민의힘 정점식 원내대표는 이날 오전 ‘투표용지 부족 사태 등 선거 관리 부실 사태의 진상 규명을 위한 특검법안에 합의하고 7월 임시국회에서 처리하기로 했다. 6월 3일 투표용지 부족 사태가 벌어진 지 48일 만이다.)

According to the agreement reached that day, the ruling and opposition parties will each recommend three members to form the National Recommendation Committee for the special counsel recommendation. The committee will receive six candidates—three each from the Korean Bar Association and the Association of Korean Law Schools—and among them, two will be recommended to the president through bipartisan agreement. The president will then appoint one of the two as the special counsel. (이날 합의안에 따르면 특검 추천을 위해 여야는 3명씩 추천해 국민추천위를 꾸리기로 했다. 국민추천위는 대한변호사협회와 법학전문대학원협의회로부터 각 3명씩 6명의 후보를 추천받고, 그중 여야 합의로 2인을 대통령에게 추천한다. 대통령이 2명 중 1명을 특검으로 임명하게 된다.)

Regarding the special counsel recommendation, the Democratic Party had advocated for a third-party recommendation method, while the People Power Party insisted on an opposition-party recommendation. On the 9th, the Democratic Party proposed a special counsel bill requiring the Korean Law Professors' Association, the Association of Korean Law Schools, and the Korean Bar Association each to recommend one candidate, from whom the president would choose one. In contrast, People Power Party leader Jang Dong-hyuk maintained as late as the 20th that the special counsel candidate should be recommended by the party. (특검 추천을 놓고 민주당은 제3자 추천 방식, 국민의힘은 야당 추천 방식을 주장해왔다. 민주당은 지난 9일 한국법학교수회, 법학전문대학원협의회, 대한변협이 각각 1명씩 특검 후보자를 추천하면 대통령이 그중 한 명을 특검으로 임명하는 특검법안을 발의했다. 반면 국민의힘 장동혁 대표는 지난 20일에도 특검 후보를 국민의힘이 추천해야 한다는 입장이었다.)

People Power Party floor leader Chung Jum-sik stated at the party's parliamentary meeting that day, "While there is no lack of regret from our position demanding an opposition-recommended special counsel," he added, "We have sufficiently secured a recommendation process that guarantees objectivity and fairness." Although an agreement was reached on the recommendation method, the scope of the investigation and the activity period still require further negotiation. Earlier, Jang Dong-hyuk had argued for an "unlimited scope of investigation." (정점식 국민의힘 원내대표는 이날 국회 의원총회에서 “야당 추천 특검을 요구해 온 입장에서 아쉬움이 없을 수는 없다”면서도 “객관성과 공정성을 담보할 특검 추천 절차는 충분히 확보했다”고 했다. 이날 특검 추천 방식엔 합의를 했지만 수사 범위, 활동 기간 등은 추가로 협의해야 한다. 장동혁 대표는 앞서 “수사 범위 무제한”을 주장했다.)

The People Power Party held a parliamentary meeting that day and decided to return to standing committee activities. They plan to hold internal elections on the 23rd to select committee chairs and proceed with a vote at the plenary session on the same day. Previously, on the 30th of last month, despite opposition from the People Power Party, the Democratic Party assigned its members to chair 11 out of 18 National Assembly committees, including the Legislation and Judiciary Committee, leading the People Power Party to boycott the committees. (국민의힘은 이날 의총을 열고 국회 상임위에 복귀하기로 했다. 23일 상임위원장 선출을 위한 당내 선거를 실시하고 같은 날 본회의에서 의결할 계획이다. 앞서 민주당은 지난달 30일 국민의힘의 반대에도 국회 18개 위원회 가운데 법사위를 포함한 11곳의 위원장에 민주당 의원을 앉혔고 국민의힘은 상임위를 보이콧해 왔다.)

item.title: President Lee: "Scope of Disputes Has Become Too Broad" Orders Ministry of Labor to Establish Criteria (李대통령 “쟁의 대상 너무 광범위해져” 노동부에 기준 마련 주문)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung said at a Cabinet meeting on the 21st, regarding recent demands by unions at several major companies for "N% of operating profit" distribution, "Is this really a subject for dispute?" adding, "Even shareholders can't do this." This implies that unions are making excessive demands. President Lee also asked, "Isn't it true that all workplaces are now arguing, and there are quite a few workplaces on the verge of striking?" (이재명 대통령은 21일 국무회의에서 최근 여러 대기업 노조가 ‘영업이익 N% 배분’을 요구하고 있는 데 대해 “이런 게 쟁의 대상이 되느냐”며 “주주도 할 수 없는 일”이라고 말했다. 노조들이 과도한 요구를 하고 있다는 취지다. 이 대통령은 “지금 온 사업장이 논쟁하고 있고, 파업할까 말까 하는 사업장도 꽤 있지 않느냐”고도 했다.)

In reality, demands for a certain percentage (N%) of operating profit as performance bonuses started in the semiconductor industry and have now spread to virtually all industrial sectors, including automotive, shipbuilding, information technology (IT), and retail. Last year, SK Hynix's labor and management agreed to pay 10% of annual operating profit as performance bonuses for the next 10 years. What further fueled the N% distribution debate was the conclusion of performance bonus negotiations between Samsung Electronics' labor and management last May. At that time, when the union threatened a general strike over performance bonuses, setting up a confrontation, Employment and Labor Minister Kim Young-hoon, a former head of the Korean Confederation of Trade Unions (KCTU), directly mediated, leading to an agreement to allocate 12% of business performance (operating profit) as performance bonuses. (실제로 영업이익 중 일정 비율(N%)을 성과급으로 달라는 요구는 반도체에서 시작해 현재 자동차, 조선, 정보기술(IT), 유통 등 사실상 전 산업군으로 번진 상태다. 지난해 SK하이닉스 노사는 앞으로 10년간 매년 영업이익의 10%를 성과급으로 지급하기로 합의했다. N% 배분 논쟁에 더욱 불을 붙인 것은 지난 5월 삼성전자 노사의 성과급 협상 타결이었다. 당시 노조가 성과급을 빌미로 총파업을 예고하며 대립각을 세우자, 민주노총 위원장 출신인 김영훈 고용노동부 장관이 직접 중재에 나서 사업 성과(영업이익)의 12%를 성과급으로 주는 쪽으로 합의가 이뤄졌다.)

Recently, Hyundai Motor union demanded 30% of net profit as performance bonuses and began partial strikes of four hours per day from the 13th, making this issue the biggest point of contention in annual wage and collective bargaining negotiations at companies this year. Kia's union is also demanding 30% of operating profit as performance bonuses. In the shipbuilding industry, HD Hyundai Heavy Industries' union has submitted a demand to management for at least 30% of operating profit to be allocated as bonus funds, and LG Uplus is also insisting on payment of 30% of operating profit. In the retail sector, Shinsegae is demanding 15% of operating profit as performance bonuses. A source at a major company said, "It looks like the N% demand has become a new standard in wage negotiations." <<> That day, President Lee said, "It seems like the scope of labor disputes is expanding too broadly," and also mentioned the 'supra-enterprise union,' the largest union at Samsung Electronics, which stated it would address the creation of the Honam semiconductor cluster in next year's collective bargaining. President Lee commented, "It seems they consider building a factory in Gwangju as a subject for labor dispute just because it might involve being transferred (to Gwangju). If you look at it that way, there's no company decision related to management rights that wouldn't be affected." He also said that such union actions are "startling the public" and that the unions are making "absurd claims." (최근엔 현대차가 순이익 30%를 성과급으로 요구하며 지난 13일부터 하루 4시간씩 부분 파업에 돌입했고, 이 문제는 올해 각 기업 임단협의 가장 큰 쟁점으로 부상했다. 기아 노조 역시 영업이익의 30%를 성과급으로 요구하고 있다. 조선 업계에서도 HD현대중공업 노조가 영업이익의 최소 30%를 성과급 재원으로 배분하라는 요구안을 사측에 전달했고, LG유플러스 역시 영업이익의 30% 지급을 주장하고 있다. 유통 업계에선 신세계가 영업이익의 15%를 성과급으로 요구한 상태다. 한 대기업 관계자는 “N% 요구가 임금 협상의 새 기준으로 자리 잡은 모양새”라고 했다.)

The industry points to the 'Yellow Envelope Act' (Amendment to the Trade Union and Labor Relations Adjustment Act), which took effect in March, as the biggest cause of this increase in labor disputes. Before the Yellow Envelope Act, the Trade Union Law limited the subjects of labor disputes to working conditions such as wages, working hours, welfare, and dismissal. Business management decisions were not subjects of labor disputes. (이 대통령은 이날 “노동쟁의 대상이 너무 광범위하게 확장되는 것 같다”며 N% 배분 요구와 함께 삼성전자 최대 노조인 ‘초기업 노조’가 내년 단체교섭에서 호남 반도체 클러스터 조성 문제를 다루겠다고 한 것도 거론했다. 이 대통령은 “광주에 공장을 지으면 혹시 (광주로) 전보될 수 있다는 것 때문에 노동쟁의 대상이라고 하는 것 같은데, 그렇게 따지면 모든 회사의 경영권 행사와 관련이 없는 게 없다”고 했다. 또 이런 노조의 움직임에 “국민이 깜짝 놀라고 있다”며 노조가 “터무니없는 주장”을 하고 있다고 했다.)

However, the Yellow Envelope Act additionally included 'business management decisions that affect working conditions' within the scope of labor disputes. The reason Samsung Electronics' supra-enterprise union claims that investment in Honam semiconductors is a 'matter for labor-management consultation' is also based on the argument that such investment decisions affect working conditions. (이처럼 노사 분쟁이 늘어난 가장 큰 원인으로 산업계에서는 지난 3월 시행된 ‘노란봉투법(노동조합 및 노동관계조정법 개정안)’을 지목하고 있다. 노란봉투법 이전의 노동조합법은 노동쟁의 대상을 임금, 근로시간, 복지, 해고 등 근로조건으로 한정했다. 사업 경영상의 결정은 노동쟁의 대상이 아니었다.)

To resolve this situation, President Lee ordered the Ministry of Employment and Labor to clearly define the subjects and criteria for labor disputes through enforcement decrees, presidential decrees, enforcement regulations, and ministry guidelines. Minister Kim Young-hoon also stated that the ministry would actively work to establish guidelines. Previously, in its 'Interpretation Guidelines for the Yellow Envelope Act' released in February, the ministry stated that layoffs and reassignments due to restructuring are subjects of labor disputes, but mergers, divisions, transfers, and sales themselves are not. (하지만 노란봉투법은 ‘근로조건에 영향을 미치는 사업 경영상의 결정’도 노동쟁의 범위에 추가로 포함시켰다. 삼성전자 초기업노조가 호남 반도체 투자를 ‘노사 협의 사항’이라고 주장하는 것도 이런 투자 결정이 근로조건에 영향을 미친다는 이유 때문이다.)

However, doubts are being raised about how effective President Lee's order will be. Because any business management decision can potentially affect workers' working conditions, if a union claims it is a 'subject for dispute' and the company claims it is not, the matter inevitably goes to the Labor Relations Commission. If both sides do not accept the Commission's mediation, they must seek a court judgment. A source from the ruling party said, "Since the President directly ordered it, the Labor Relations Commission will try to mediate according to the guidelines set by the government, but will the unions accept this?" adding, "Even if new guidelines are issued, ending disputes early is a different matter." (이 대통령은 이런 상황을 풀기 위해 고용노동부가 시행령, 대통령령, 시행규칙, 노동부 지침 등으로 노동쟁의 대상과 기준을 명확히 정하라고 지시했다. 김영훈 장관도 노동부가 적극 지침 마련에 나서겠다고 했다. 앞서 노동부는 지난 2월 발표한 ‘노란봉투법 해석 지침’에서 정리해고, 구조조정에 따른 배치 전환 등은 노동쟁의 대상이 되지만, 합병·분할·양도·매각 등 자체는 노동쟁의 대상이 아니라고 한 바 있다.)

Both major umbrella union federations immediately reacted to President Lee's remarks that day. The KCTU issued a statement saying, "The establishment of new factories or relocation of production lines is inseparably linked to working conditions such as existing workers' job security, workplace changes, family relocation, and work intensity," and "We express deep regret over the President's biased and distorted view of labor." The KCTU also stated that the President was making "arbitrary ideas" and "irresponsible remarks." The Federation of Korean Trade Unions (FKTU) also said in a spokesperson's commentary, "What the government should do is not create new criteria to limit the scope of labor disputes, but enforce the law in accordance with the intent of the revised labor law so that basic labor rights are fully guaranteed." (하지만 이 대통령의 지시에 얼마나 실효성이 있겠느냐는 의구심이 제기되고 있다. 어떤 사업 경영상 결정이든 근로자의 근로 조건에 영향을 미칠 수 있기 때문에, 노조가 ‘쟁의 대상’이라고 주장하고 회사는 ‘아니다’라고 주장하면 노동위로 갈 수밖에 없고, 양측이 노동위 중재에도 승복하지 못하면 법원 판단을 받아야 한다는 것이다. 여권 관계자는 “대통령이 직접 지시한 만큼 노동위는 정부가 정한 지침대로 중재하려 하겠지만 노조가 이걸 받아들이겠느냐”며 “새로운 지침이 있어도 조기에 분쟁을 종료시키는 건 다른 문제”라고 했다.)

Professor Park Ji-soon of Korea University Law School said, "The clause in the Yellow Envelope Act was set so broadly from the start that the government and President keep having to draw lines," adding, "Supplementary legislation is needed now, even at this late stage, to minimize confusion in the field." (이 대통령의 이날 언급에 양대 노총은 즉각 반발했다. 민주노총은 “신규 공장 설립이나 생산 라인 이전은 기존 노동자의 고용 안정, 근무지 변경, 가족의 이주, 노동 강도 등 노동 조건과 떼려야 뗄 수 없는 문제”라며 “대통령의 편향되고 왜곡된 노동관에 깊은 유감을 표한다”는 성명을 냈다. 민주노총은 이 대통령이 “독단적 발상” “무책임한 발언”을 하고 있다고도 했다. 한국노총도 대변인 논평에서 “정부가 해야 할 일은 노동쟁의 범위를 새롭게 제한하는 기준을 만드는 것이 아니라 개정 노동법 취지에 따라 노동 기본권이 충실히 보장될 수 있도록 법률을 집행하는 것”이라고 했다.)
